sloka: शोचता च मया दृष्टं प्राकारेण समावृतम् ।काञ्चनेन विकृष्टेन गृहोपवनमुत्तमम् ।। ५.५८.५३ ।।।।
transliteration: śocatā ca mayā dṛṣṭaṁ prākāreṇa samāvṛtam ।kāñcanena vikṛṣṭena gṛhopavanamuttamam ।। 5.58.53 ।।।।

translations.english: "While worrying like that I saw a long golden boundary wall surrounding a splendid home garden. (upabana)
